title:
Epic which will check if the selected project does not have a dataset, if it has one it will take the user to the
next step in model configuration. If it does not have a dataset it will show a modal with an error message.

payload
  - gridId: the grid where the project is selected.
  - modalToClose: the modal that contains the grid.
  - modalToOpen: the modal for the next step on model config.
  - errorModal: the modal that has the error Message.
name: SelectModelConfigProjectType
